title: History outlives removal, archive and asset deletion (no audit screen)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset enrolled on a schedule (standard enrolment steps).
  3. A disposable test asset (name it with ZZAUTOTEST) with a completed service (Mark complete > Completed elsewhere, Reset date 1 Sep 2026), enrolled on a schedule you may archive.
custom_steps:
1. Remove the asset from the schedule (Maintenance tab > schedule menu > Remove from schedule); enrol it again and read the pre-filled last service date.
  2. Archive the schedule, restore it, enrol the asset again and read the pre-filled date.
  3. Delete the test asset the way the app deletes an asset today; open the worklist.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Enrolling again pre-fills 1 Sep 2026: removal kept the history.
  • After archive and restore the pre-fill is again 1 Sep 2026: archiving kept the history.
  • The asset is deleted as today and its rows leave the worklist. That its maintenance history and audit entries are still kept in the data cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows them. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S21 (S21-R6, S21-N1, S21-N2, S21-N3); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-E1: “Removing a schedule from an asset does not destroy history”
  • S21-N2: “An unenrolled asset and an archived schedule keep their entries”
  • S21-R6: “An asset itself is deleted as ShopView deletes it today; its maintenance history stays in the data, with no screen to view it in v1”
  • S21-R6: “Audit entries will outlive the objects they describe. Maintenance records, readings, certificates and audit entries are never hard deleted”
  • S21-N1: “A work order link is never hard deleted, or the trail goes with it”
